privileged_state_note: the 11-value observation includes simulator ground-truth block coordinates; this is not a real-robot sensor policy
paired_by: same seed, same first SCORE_BLOCK entry (reset pre-roll)

gate.note: gate uses locked-target real BlockScore and our own Drop only; reward and final score are not gate evidence
